question: What is the name of the process of gases being outpoured from the interior of the solid earth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Degassing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This started the evolution of the present atmosphere.
 
• The early atmosphere largely contained water vapour, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, methane, ammonia and very little of free oxygen.
 
• The process through which the gases were outpoured from the interior is called degassing.
